description: This file defines a report for vehicle expenses in an ERP system, including data retrieval, chart generation, and report column definitions.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the vehicle expenses report.

methods.name: get_vehicle_log_data
methods.description: Retrieves vehicle log data within specified date range and filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_period_dates
methods.description: Determines start and end dates based on filter settings.

methods.name: get_service_expense
methods.description: Calculates total service expense for a given vehicle log.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data for fuel and service expenses over periods.
